attempt_slots.definition: Five included scheduled slots per solver result

under_two_success_rows.definition: Rows retained in counts but uninformative for time contrasts

eligible_solver_seasons.definition: Person-years with at least five distinct included confirmation competitions

no_success_seasons.definition: Eligible seasons with no successful solve

unidentified_extrema.definition: Selected extrema whose leave-focal-out peer matrix has rank below four

available_extrema.definition: Eligible seasons with successful and identified selected extrema

R.definition: Geometric mean exp(-peer shared contrast) across available person-years

R_arithmetic.definition: Arithmetic mean of estimated adjusted/observed ratios

R_solver_weighted.definition: Average log ratio within solver, then equally across solvers, exponentiated

training_beta.definition: Pooled pre-2019 exploration solver-demeaned position coefficients

2019_2022_F.definition: Era-restricted tier measure with full-window skill references: F

2019_2022_gamma_share.definition: Era-restricted tier measure with full-window skill references: gamma_share

2019_2022_finals.definition: Era-restricted tier measure with full-window skill references: finals

2019_2022_successes.definition: Era-restricted tier measure with full-window skill references: successes

2019_2022_R.definition: Geometric seasonal ratio in the named calendar-year era

2023_2025_F.definition: Era-restricted tier measure with full-window skill references: F

2023_2025_gamma_share.definition: Era-restricted tier measure with full-window skill references: gamma_share

2023_2025_finals.definition: Era-restricted tier measure with full-window skill references: finals

2023_2025_successes.definition: Era-restricted tier measure with full-window skill references: successes

2023_2025_R.definition: Geometric seasonal ratio in the named calendar-year era

R_ci95.definition: Amendment B: exponentiated mean-recentered linear log-R percentile endpoints

R_bootstrap_raw_ci95.definition: Uncentered reselecting percentile interval, diagnostic only

R_bootstrap_displacement.definition: Bootstrap mean log R minus original log R

R_fixed_ci95.definition: Amendment A: fixed original extrema with competition times solver weights

bootstrap_absent_seasons_mean.definition: Mean roster seasons absent after competition and solver resampling

bootstrap_distinct_competitions_mean.definition: Mean distinct included confirmation competitions in a draw

verdict.definition: Registered interval decision, conditional on accepted validation gate and coverage checks

universe_exploration_competitions.definition: Hash-defined exploration competitions in the full raw export

universe_confirmation_competitions.definition: Hash-defined confirmation competitions in the full raw export

extra_pool_finals.definition: Included finals with at least one extra-pool scramble row

extra_pool_solver_results.definition: Included solver-final rows in finals with extra pools

dnf_started_rate.definition: DNF divided by positive attempts plus DNF; DNS excluded

complete_success_results.definition: Included solver-final rows with five successful attempts

eligible_season_solvers.definition: Distinct solvers represented on the fixed eligible person-year roster
